summary: According to official warnings, this drug can cause heart rhythm issues such as a delayed electrical signal through the heart called PR interval prolongation, as well as severe skin reactions [3]. Clinical studies have noted reasons for stopping or monitoring treatment, including unexpected harmful events and severely elevated liver function tests [5][6]. Additionally, a small computer model—not tests on people—estimated a medium score for liver risk and a low score for heart risk [M].
